title: New Measurements of the Radio Photosphere of Mira Based on Data from the JVLA and ALMA
question: Do JVLA and ALMA continuum data at 46, 96 and 229 GHz match the radio photosphere model of Mira A (size, shape, flux, brightness structure), and what are the properties of Mira B?

data.bands: ALMA Band 3 (94 GHz) and Band 6 (229 GHz); JVLA Q band 46 GHz

evidence.quote: represents the flux density as a function of frequency predicted by the radio photosphere model of RM97

what.value: 338 GHz ALMA flux points for Mira A and B

evidence.quote: Additional data points at 338 GHz from Ramstedt et al. (2014) are also included.
The absolute flux density scale was calculated using the latest time-dependent flux density values for 3C48 from Perley & Butler (2013).

recipe.method: AIPS calibration with 3C48 flux scale, NRAO150 bandpass, J0215-0222 gains, SiO maser phase self-cal
Self-cal on Mira AB continuum, phase then amp+phase
AIPS imaging, robust 0, 5 mas cells, circular restoring beam

recipe.goal: Fit size, shape, flux of Mira A and B
recipe.method: Uniform elliptical disk fits to visibilities and elliptical Gaussian fits to images
assumptions: distance 110 pc; Tb=2Sc^2/(k nu^2 pi theta_maj theta_min)

recipe.method: Compare multi-component visibility models (ring, point, Gaussian) and residual images for 229 GHz

answer_key.quantity: Mira A 229 GHz flux density (uniform disk)
Mira A photospheric radius at 46/96/229 GHz

evidence.quote: 4.5$\times10^{13}$ cm (3.0 AU) at 46 GHz, 3.9$\times10^{13}$ cm (2.6 AU) at 96 GHz, and 3.6$\times10^{13}$ cm (2.4 AU) at 229 GHz
we derive a radius for Mira B of $\approx2.0\times10^{13}$ cm

answer_key.quantity: Disk+Gaussian model hot spot fraction at 229 GHz
answer_key.value: 39% of 151 mJy in Gaussian FWHM 26 mas

evidence.quote: The total flux density in this model was 151 mJy, with 39% in a Gaussian component with FWHM 26 mas

not_stated_but_needed: Number of clean iterations, clean masks/thresholds in AIPS
Which flagged channels containing line emission in JVLA data
Data selection and weighting for uv fits (OMFIT settings)
Whether ALMA self-cal reference antenna and models were specified
missing_for_reproduction: JVLA data in archive but program details limited
score_reason: Public ALMA data and clear calibration, but AIPS imaging and fitting details are partial.
rediscovery_reason: Public SV data, numeric results in tables, fairly complete recipe for ALMA part.
